I replied to Tobias in his DM: his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is **Dock 26**. He told me this himself in this same DM on Oct 14 and said it applies to his pickups on the Heron project from then on. The DM channel itself only shows today's question, so I found his Oct 14 message in the brain.

One thing needs an admin to look at it. The brain saved his private DM messages under his own private source (`private-tobias-rendle`), but they're tagged `visibility: "world"`. Only Tobias should see them, and my earlier note from Oct 14 flagged the same problem.
